categories.main_business_segments: Anji Microelectronics Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development and industrialization of key semiconductor materials. Its main product lines include chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) slurries, functional wet electronic chemicals, and electroplating solutions and additives, serving integrated circuit manufacturing and advanced packaging sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary core technologies covering chemical formulations and manufacturing processes such as metal surface oxidation, corrosion inhibition, polishing rate control, CMP surface morphology control, photoresist cleaning, selective etching, electronic-grade additive purification, abrasive preparation, and electroplating additive technologies. It emphasizes advanced chemical mechanical planarization, wet cleaning, etching, and electrochemical deposition processes, with significant R&D in nano-abrasives and electronic-grade chemicals.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor manufacturers engaged in logic chips, memory chips (3D NAND, DRAM), analog chips, power devices, sensors, and third-generation semiconductors. The company serves both mature and advanced process nodes and advanced packaging markets, with customers primarily in China mainland, Taiwan, and overseas regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production bases in Shanghai and Ningbo, and subsidiaries in Taiwan, Singapore, France, and Beijing. It serves global markets, with increasing overseas market penetration, especially in Taiwan and other international regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anji Technology operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a high-end materials supplier, providing critical consumables for wafer fabrication and advanced packaging processes. It also strengthens its position by developing core raw materials to ensure supply chain security and independence.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation and R&D investment focused on expanding its '3+1' technology platform: full-category CMP slurry matrix, multi-product line functional wet electronic chemicals, enhanced electroplating solutions, and core raw material self-sufficiency. It targets advanced process nodes, new materials, and emerging packaging technologies, while also pursuing strategic investments and potential acquisitions to extend its semiconductor materials value chain.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products and materials to semiconductor manufacturers. The company employs a direct sales model with long-term customer contracts and product qualification processes. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Anji Technology has broken foreign monopolies in CMP slurries and certain functional wet electronic chemicals, establishing itself as a leading domestic supplier with growing global market share. Its CMP slurry global market share has increased steadily to approximately 11% in 2024, and its wet electronic chemical cleaning products hold about 4% of the global market. It competes with international semiconductor materials suppliers by leveraging innovation, localization, and customer-centric services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 1.835 billion, a 48.24% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 533.6 million, up 32.51%. The company has maintained a compound annual growth rate of 45% in revenue since 2019. Total assets reached RMB 3.45 billion, growing 32.59%, supported by increased bank financing and operational cash flow growth of 46.69%. R&D investment accounted for 18.13% of revenue, reflecting strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anji Technology emphasizes high technical barriers, innovation-driven development, and comprehensive product portfolios covering critical semiconductor manufacturing processes. It offers one-stop solutions with localized production, strong IP protection, and customized products tailored to advanced process nodes and packaging technologies. The company’s ability to secure core raw materials independently and provide reliable supply enhances its competitive edge and customer trust.
